title: Nandano
text: 1. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Nandano devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Pucchāmi taṃ Gotama bhūripaññaṃ || anāvaṭaṃ Bhagavato ñāṇadassanaṃ || [page 053] II. 2. 7.] ANĀTHAPIṆḌIKA-VAGGA 2. 53 Kathaṃ vidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti || kathaṃ vidhaṃ paññāvantam vadanti || kathaṃ vidhaṃ dukkham aticca iriyati || kathaṃ vidhaṃ devatā pūjayantīti || || 2. Yo sīlavā paññavā bhāvitatto || samāhito jhānarato satimā || sabb-assa sokā vigatā pahīnā || khīṇāsavo antimadehadhārī || || Tathāvidhaṃ sīlavantam vadanti || tathāvidhaṃ paññāvantaṃ vadanti || tathāvidho dukkhaṃ aticca iriyati || tathāvidhaṃ devatā pūjayantīti || ||
